proposed.explanation: Source-audited against RA 9266 IRR Sections 3(27), 3(32), 20(4), and 33; the answer turns on retained copyright ownership, original-project use, and written consent for repetition or other projects.
proposed.text: A client who received architectural plans for one residential project wants to construct an identical building on another property using the same plans and specifications. What does RA 9266 Section 33 require?

options.text: No consent is needed because the client paid for the original plans
Written consent from the architect is required for repetition or use for another project
Consent is required only if the second project is in the same city
Consent is required only when the second project has a different contractor
